headline: Lazoomi went from losing money every month to 4.91× ROAS
summary: A premium reed diffuser brand, an ad account nobody was steering, and a system that fixed both.

before.title: A strong product, held back by its ads.
constraints: No way to scale without losing ROAS
audit: No follow-up from the previous media buyers
Ad fatigue pushed cost per purchase up, and nothing was done about it
No media plan, no creative plan, no offer tests, no pricing or competitor research

levers.title: Creative funnel
levers.detail: Test, define, scale, duplicate. Every winner became the next round of tests.

levers.title: Multi-offer testing
levers.detail: Offers tested until one reached the order value the target ROAS needed for real profit.

levers.title: Core price
levers.detail: Priced above 90% of competitors, to reach the customer the brand was built for.

levers.title: Product selection
levers.detail: Car and home diffusers were both tested. Car brought more traffic and sales, so it got the focus.

levers.title: Cross-sell
levers.detail: The refill bottle at add-to-cart and in recommendations. It sold heavily.

levers.title: Order value
levers.detail: Target EGP 1,000 per order. The year averaged EGP 969.

levers.title: Free shipping
levers.detail: Free shipping over EGP 1,500 to lift basket size. It did not work.

levers.title: Bundles
levers.detail: Winning scents, scents with the refill, and car plus home in one order.

levers.title: Scaling
levers.detail: Once tests were validated, spend went up and kept a profitable ROAS.

hooks.note: About 10% of a monthly budget planned above EGP 500,000 went to new creative. Hook rate is the share of viewers still watching after the first seconds; tests from January to April 2026.
